vibe_rationale: Wellness-first programme with real practitioners and a music bill, but new, mainstream-leaning in its headliners and run by a markets operator rather than a scene.
fit_notes: Adult wellness-led audience with daytime breathwork and movement a health brand could host, and an open sponsorship form already in use; community depth and precedent are unproven for an early edition, and kids' yoga pulls the audience slightly younger. It is an NSW event, so direct activation is possible.
